## Off the grill

| Dish                         | Notes                     |
|------------------------------|---------------------------|
| Classic smash burgers        | Cheddar or pepper jack    |
| Black bean burgers           | Vegan                     |
| Veggie & halloumi skewers    | Vegetarian                |
| Corn on the cob              | Chili-lime butter         |

## Sides & sweets

- Watermelon feta salad
- Grandma's potato salad
- S'mores by the firepit

## What to bring

Just yourself! If you'd like to contribute, a drink to share or a lawn chair is
always welcome. If you're planning a dish, contact Rob so we don't end up
with five potato salads.
